item.title: Dense fog advisory in effect Saturday morning
item.description: A dense fog advisory is in effect across Long Island through 10 a.m. Saturday, with visibility expected to drop to a quarter-mile or less.

item.title: Dense fog advisory extended through 11 a.m. Sunday
item.description: A dense fog advisory has been extended ro 11 a.m. Sunday on Long Island.

item.title: Cops: Riverhead man charged with Leandra’s Law DWI after stop on Northville Turnpike
item.description: A Riverhead man was arrested Saturday afternoon and charged with felony driving while intoxicated under Leandra’s Law after a traffic stop.

item.title: Latest real estate transfers
item.description: What's the local real estate market doing? Stay up to date on the latest trends with the weekly report of title transfers in Riverhead Town and adjacent hamlets in Southampton Town.

item.title: Planning Board OKs town square lot line changes
item.description: The Riverhead Planning Board on Thursday granted conditional approval for lot line changes needed for the town square hotel project to proceed.

item.title: Anti-ICE protesters march from Route 58 to Riverhead Town Hall Sunday afternoon
item.description: The Riverhead protest march was the fourth anti-ICE action this weekend across Long Island, amid a recent uptick in ICE enforcement activities and arrests.

item.title: Jamesport horse farm bought by Riverhead council member and his wife
item.description: A 107.8-acre preserved horse farm on Main Road in Jamesport was purchased last month by Riverhead Council Member Ken Rothwell and his wife Debra, who will continue its equestrian use under a new name, Thunder Road Stables.

item.title: Preliminary tests of dead geese in Riverhead suggest Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza: DEC
item.description: A USDA lab is conducting more tests to confirm the state's findings, a DEC spokesperson said. The public should avoid contact with any sick or dead birds.

item.title: Dorothy F. Dinnigan, 90
item.description: Dorothy F. Dinnigan of Riverhead died March 5, 2026, at home. She was 90 years old.

item.title: Keith R. Mackie, 44
item.description: Keith R. Mackie, formerly of Riverhead, died March 4, 2026, at home in Mattituck. He was 44 years old.
